simple.meaning: מָזוֹר (mâzôwr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a bandage , i.e. remedy ; hence, a sore (as needing a compress).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

definitions.short: a bandage , i.e. remedy ; hence, a sore (as needing a compress)
definitions.full: H4205. mazor מָזוֺר noun [masculine] wound (as needing to have its matter pressed out ) — figurative of injury to, or sufferings of, Israel and Judah: מָזוֺר Hosea 5:13 also Jer 30:13 (Gf Che RVm; but accents Ew Ges Gie AV RV for pressing , i.e. binding up); מְזֹרוֺ Hosea 5:13 (compare III. זור Isa 1:6 ). — מָזוֺר Obadiah 7 see below מזר . זָזָא see below זוז .
definitions.rootNote: or מָזֹר ; from 2115 in the sense of binding up;
